final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT p.rental_id AS rental_id, i.store_id AS store_id, SUM(p.amount) AS total FROM payment p JOIN rental r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id GROUP BY p.rental_id, i.store_id), s2 AS (SELECT store_id, AVG(total) AS avg_total FROM s1 GROUP BY store_id), s3 AS (SELECT s1.rental_id, s1.store_id, s1.total AS total, s1.total - s2.avg_total AS diff FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s1.store_id = s2.store_id WHERE s1.total > s2.avg_total) SELECT store_id, SUM(total), AVG(diff) FROM s3 GROUP BY store_id
